title: pittosporum lanceolatum
intro: Pittosporum lanceolatum, commonly known as the Kawakawa or New Zealand Pepper Tree, is a plant native to New Zealand. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and soothe respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Kawakawa include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Kawakawa has been traditionally used to relieve pain and reduce stress, with its therapeutic actions providing relief from various health conditions.
